items.title: 9.4 Developing Effective Marketing and Sales Strategies (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 9.4 (PDF 216), rewritten 2026-10-27 to follow the book paragraph for paragraph.

blocks.text: Marketing (product ki tashheer) aur sales (farokht) har kamyab karobar ke zaroori hisse hain. Yeh karobar ko customers lane, sales barhane aur brand (karobar ki pehchan) ko mazboot karne mein madad dete hain. Is hisse mein hum Pakistan ki misalon se dekhenge ke marketing aur sales ki mo-assar (effective) strategies kaise banayi jati hain.

blocks.prompt: Mo-assar (effective) marketing ka aham hissa kya hai (MCQ 7)?
blocks.explanation: (b) Strong brand identity, yaani mazboot brand pehchan.

items: Marketing aur sales: customers lana, sales barhana, brand banana.
